extracted.name: Smokey Sausage, Kale & Sweet Potato Soup
extracted.description: This smokey sausage, kale, and sweet potato soup recipe is packed with kale, sausage, chickpeas, and feta, all simmered in a savory, comforting broth.
ingredient_lines: 3 cups Hillshire Farm® Smoked Sausage, sliced into 1-inch rounds
1 teaspoon Crumbled feta cheese or goat cheese
1 teaspoon Freshly ground black pepper, for garnish
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion; cook until onion releases some moisture, about 5 minutes. Stir in sausage, chickpeas, sweet potato, and garlic; season with paprika, chipotle powder, coriander, cumin, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.

Add stock to the pot; bring to a simmer. Cook until sweet potato has softened, 10 to 15 minutes. Stir in kale; cook until wilted, about 1 minute. Top servings with cheese and freshly ground black pepper.
